title: PM daily scratchpad - Maya Chen - 2026-03-04
content:
Daily scratchpad — quick log / TODOs / notes

Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Maya Chen (PM, Hosted API)
Context: Wrapping up beta for hosted-api rolling launch. Focus today on PRD edits, stakeholder follow-ups, and launch checklist items.

Top priorities
- Finalize PRD language for canary rollback criteria (PROD-2412) — action: add metrics and thresholds (p95 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 1% over 5m).
- Confirm infra capacity numbers with SRE (Evan) for burst windows next week.
- Get legal sign-off on data retention blurb for hosted customers (Priya).

Morning meetings (notes)
- 09:00 — Weekly product sync w/ engineering
  - Quick status: canary rollout plan looks good; infra asked for final traffic profile by EOD
  - Action: send traffic profile (Maya) + confirm autoscaling knobs (Evan)
- 10:30 — UX review (console rollout) w/ design
  - Need to tweak wording for "model pinning" dialog — make explicit that pinning prevents automatic fallback.
  - Follow-up: small copy change + screenshot (Mateo)
- 11:30 — Legal check-in
  - Priya requested the short data retention blurb and one-line explanation of customer data flow for the sales one-pager
  - Action: draft blurb and route via Priya by 16:00

PRD edits (live)
- Section: Rollout and rollback
  - Add canary thresholds (see Top priorities)
  - Add automated fallback policy description: when fallback triggers, notify customer via dashboard and email; provide link to rollback history
- Section: Observability
  - Add example dashboards: p50/p95 latency, token-rate, kv-cache hit ratio, model-variant traffic split
  - Add retention notes: 30d default, 90d enterprise add-on
- Section: Cost controls
  - Clarify that batching settings are suggestions in Optimize and can be overridden per route

Launch checklist (status)
- [x] Finalize feature flags and canary gating (engineering)
- [ ] Confirm SRE capacity numbers for planned traffic (blocked - waiting on Evan)
- [x] Docs draft for public API (first pass)
- [ ] Legal sign-off on retention + sales one-pager blurb (in progress)
- [ ] Add canary threshold language to PRD (in progress)
- [ ] Prepare support triage playbook and escalation matrix (to draft this afternoon)

Stakeholder follow-ups
- Evan (SRE) — need traffic profile (send template) + expected GPU pool sizes for 3x baseline
- Priya (Legal) — route retention blurb + one-line customer-data flow explanation
- Mateo (Design) — final console screenshots for model pinning dialog by EOD
- Sales (Alex) — confirm demo script updated to show canary fallback behavior

Blockers / open questions
- SRE numbers still pending — blocks canned load test schedule
- Do we want to include explicit per-customer cost estimate calculator in launch? (low priority)
- Should fallback email use tenant-level preferences or global defaults? (ask CS)

Notes to self
- When drafting rollback criteria, include both absolute and relative measures (absolute: p95 latency threshold; relative: >30% degradation vs baseline)
- Keep copy simple for non-technical customers; include a "what this means for you" callout in docs

Next actions (today)
1) Draft and push PRD edits (add thresholds + observability examples) — finish by 13:30
2) Send traffic profile template to Evan + schedule 30m sync if no reply by 15:00
3) Draft retention blurb and send to Priya by 16:00
4) Prep support triage doc skeleton and share with CS for input
5) Ping Mateo for final screenshots, remind about accessibility checks

Quick TODO (small items)
- Add PROD-2412 link to PRD doc
- Update Confluence launch timeline with yesterday's notes
- Reply to Alex (sales) re: demo script changes

Scratch / rough thoughts
- Consider adding per-route "safety buffer" parameter for autoscaling to reduce risk during initial ramp
- Post-launch: schedule 1-week "guardrail" review with eng+sre to surface regressions

End of scratchpad

(Will tidy and move to PRD when thresholds + legal blurb approved)
